theorem lg_target (R : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [Field R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [Module.Finite R L] [LieAlgebra.IsKilling R L] : LieAlgebra.IsKilling R ↥(LieDerivation.ad R L).range := by
  let ad_range : LieSubalgebra R (LieDerivation R L L) := (LieDerivation.ad R L).range
  let ad_range_ideal : LieIdeal R L := ad_range.asIdeal
  let kill_form_ad_range := killingForm R ad_range_ideal
  have nondegenerate_ad_range : Nondegenerate kill_form_ad_range :=
    by {
      haveI : IsLieAbelian ↥ad_range_ideal → ad_range_ideal = ⊥ :=
        LieAlgebra.IsKilling.ideal_eq_bot_of_isLieAbelian R L
      exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_nondegenerate R ad_range_ideal kill_form_ad_range this
    }
  exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_nondegenerate R ad_range_ideal kill_form_ad_range nondegenerate_ad_range
